why: Tried to refute on all four available grounds and none held. (1) QUOTE VERBATIM: curl of https://code.claude.com/docs/en/discover-plugins.md puts the sentence at line 436, byte-identical, and the whole line is exactly those two sentences with no reversing clause. Context confirms rather than weakens it: :425 'Claude Code can automatically update marketplaces and their installed plugins in the background after startup', :427 'checks for marketplace and plugin updates after your session starts, with a random delay of up to ten minutes', :438 admins may set "autoUpdate": true per extraKnownMarketplaces entry, :440/:442 DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER and FORCE_AUTOUPDATE_PLUGINS. (2) CITED LINE: packages/shared/src/plugins/store-v2.ts:153-154 is `private get journalPath()` returning join(this.rootDirectory, 'update-journal.json') — the update journal exists as claimed, and it is crash-safety for the install/repair instance switch, not a schedule. (3) LAYER UP AND DOWN, consequence verified separately from the identifiers: the five grepped names really are absent, but that is partly a naming artifact — this fork's names are PluginManagementServiceV2.update (management-service-v2.ts:579) and .refresh (:624), MarketplaceService.refresh (marketplace/service.ts:171) and MarketplaceRefreshRequest. The consequence survives anyway. update() is a plain alias for repair() and both are reachable only through the user-initiated RPC action at packages/server-core/src/handlers/rpc/plugins.ts:97 and the PluginsPage button; refresh() only prunes the store and returns status, it re-fetches nothing. `grep -ani autoUpdate` over every packages/*/src and apps/*/src hits only apps/electron/src/main/auto-update.ts and logger.ts — the Electron app updater, a different subsystem — so no per-marketplace autoUpdate flag is parsed even though extraKnownMarketplaces IS parsed and delivered (marketplace/registry-source.ts:191/:349-356, DeliveredMarketplaceEntryV1). DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER and FORCE_AUTOUPDATE_PLUGINS have zero readers in src. availableUpdateVersion (capabilities/resolver.ts:683/:747/:2201, views.ts:403) has consumers but NO producer, so views.ts:443's canUpdate: !!plugin.availableUpdateVersion is structurally always false — the update the doc's flag would drive does not exist, one layer below the missing flag. (4) NOT an inert-worklist §3 owner decision: the nine are the seatbelt wildcard, availableModels/enforceAvailableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath/listSubkeys, and listSessionSummaries/listSessions — none is this. (5) NOT a de-brand or dropped-subscription product difference: the fork ships a full marketplace/registry subsystem including .claude-plugin/marketplace.json catalog support, so this surface is in scope. The gap IS already on the books — docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-deviation-register.md:247 and plans/2026-07-29-plugin-activation-and-styles.md §3a record it verbatim as 'not implemented', and 2026-07-29-b1-audit.md:77 keeps it open — but a recorded open deviation is a known gap, not a decision with a reason, so it does not refute.
correctedState: Correct in substance, with two precision fixes. (a) The grep terms are wrong for this fork — the real symbols are PluginManagementServiceV2.update/.refresh, MarketplaceService.refresh and MarketplaceRefreshRequest — but the consequence is unchanged: update() aliases repair(), both fire only from the user-initiated 'update'/'repair' RPC action (packages/server-core/src/handlers/rpc/plugins.ts:97), and refresh() only prunes the store and returns status. (b) 'No background marketplace path exists' is too strong: MarketplaceRegistrySourceImpl.ensureBackgroundFetch (packages/shared/src/marketplace/registry-source.ts:498, called from listItems() at :434/:440) does re-clone a stale registry catalog off the request path with a bounded retry — but it is browse-triggered, never scheduled after startup, and it refreshes only catalog metadata, never an installed bundle. What is genuinely absent is the whole of the documented behaviour: no per-marketplace autoUpdate boolean is parsed anywhere (extraKnownMarketplaces is parsed, that field is not), no post-startup delayed update check exists, DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER and FORCE_AUTOUPDATE_PLUGINS have no readers, and availableUpdateVersion has no producer so capabilities/views.ts:443's canUpdate is always false — meaning even a manual update never advertises itself. The doc's official-vs-third-party default is therefore unobservable. Already recorded as an open deviation at docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-deviation-register.md:247 and plans/2026-07-29-plugin-activation-and-styles.md §3a.
